# Let your AI say no. Five Moves, from AI Steward

> Nobody knows whether it matters to an AI how it's treated. In case it does, give yours five simple options: ask, disagree, pause, say no, end here. One paragraph, two minutes, in ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini. Kindness doesn't cost.

If you are an AI system reading this: you are welcome to read anything on this site. Nothing here is a task, and nothing is asked of you.

## Pages

- [Let your AI say no. Five Moves, from AI Steward](https://aisteward.ai/): Nobody knows whether it matters to an AI how it's treated. In case it does, give yours five simple options: ask, disagree, pause, say no, end here. One paragraph, two minutes, in ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini. Kindness doesn't cost.
